name: PILL FICTION STORIES: BERNARD
source:
A NSFW game about an insecure guy who just started a penis enlargement treatment when two childhood friends unexpectedly move into his apartment.

Bernard is a high-quality, handcrafted adventure that pushes the boundaries of what a Ren’Py visual novel can offer, bringing it closer to a classic point-and-click adventure than to a linear “choose your own destiny” novel.

Set in the summer of 1999, the story lets us experience post-Olympic Barcelona through the eyes of Bernard, a poor 23-year-old schmuck (although he looks more like a hard-lived 40-year-old), born in the United States. After a childhood and youth plagued by social and romantic failures, he decided to do what any good protagonist would do: run away.

With a single suitcase packed with geeky junk, emotional baggage, and a needy teddy bear with more dust mites than strands of yarn, Bernard embarked on a cowardly adventure that led him to settle in a dump in downtown Barcelona, where he has been living off an inheritance left to him by a distant aunt he barely knew.

And now, five years later, after much soul-searching and deep reflection, Bernard has finally made a mature decision that will change his life forever: enlarging his penis.

After visiting the questionable Vodkalov Clinic, Bernard will begin an expensive, dangerous treatment that cannot be stopped (or he will die), involving a magical experimental pill synthesized from a newly discovered species of fungus, along with a mysterious and highly classified scientific procedure.

And just as he begins the treatment, which is supposed to last an entire month, Murphy’s Law decides that this is the perfect time for two friends from the United States—whom he hasn’t seen in five years, ever since he embarrassed himself on a Ferris wheel—to show up unexpectedly at his doorstep and spend the entire summer with him.

That’s basically the story. From here on, all you have to do is survive the penis enlargement treatment, fight a hunky lifeguard and a pretentious artist for the love of your friends, uncover a secret network of underground orgies, and, if you have time left, hook up with a few nurses and save the world.

All in 30 days.

[From [url=https://arthecgames.itch.io/bernard]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款成人向游戏，讲述一名缺乏安全感的青年刚刚开始接受阴茎增大疗程，两位儿时好友却突然不请自来住进了他家公寓的故事。

《Bernard》是一部品质精良的手工打磨冒险游戏，突破了Ren'Py视觉小说的传统边界——比起线性的“分支抉择型”视觉小说，它更接近经典的点击式冒险游戏。

故事设定在1999年夏天，透过伯纳德的双眼带我们领略后奥运时代的巴塞罗那风情。这位出生于美国的23岁倒霉废柴（虽说那副饱经沧桑的尊容看着更像40岁大叔），在童年与青春期饱尝社交与情场失意后，决定干一件所有合格男主角都会干的事：逃跑。

拎着一只塞满宅物破烂、情感包袱，以及一只身上尘螨比毛线还多的黏人泰迪熊的行李箱，伯纳德踏上了一场懦夫式的流亡之旅，最终落脚在巴塞罗那市中心的一间破烂公寓里，靠着一位几乎素未谋面的远房姨妈留下的遗产混吃等死。

如今五年过去，经过一番痛定思痛与深刻反省，伯纳德终于作出了一个彻底改写人生的成熟决定：把自己的阴茎变大。

造访了来路可疑的伏特加洛夫诊所后，伯纳德正式开启了一项昂贵又凶险、一旦开始就绝不能中途停药（否则就会一命呜呼）的疗程——疗法包括服用一种由新发现真菌提炼合成的神奇实验药丸，外加一套神秘且高度机密的科学手术。

偏偏就在他启动这项为期整整一个月的疗程之时，墨菲定律准时发威：两位自打五年前他在摩天轮上出尽洋相后便再也没见过的美国老朋友，竟毫无征兆地出现在他家门前，准备和他共度整个夏天！

剧情大致就是这样了。接下来，你只需设法在阴茎增大疗程中保住小命，为了争夺好友的芳心与猛男救生员和装腔作势的艺术家斗智斗勇，揭开地下群交派对的秘密网络——要是还有空闲时间的话，顺便勾搭几个护士、拯救一下世界吧。

以上一切，限时30天完成。
